notes: Direct SPEPEHook constructor takes PoolManager and launch token in that order. Mine CREATE2 for low 14 bits 0x20cc. IMD and the SIMD vault 0x3dd5f73dd1a4e62630fad3909673f130ad429985 are fixed. Static 1.25% LP fee plus an IMD hook fee starting at 30% in the initialization Robinhood block, decreasing by 3 percentage points per local block to zero at offset 10; initialization and fee calculation use ArbSys(0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000064).arbBlockNumber(), with block.number only when ArbSys has no code on a plain EVM. Fees use actual fills, with specified-side excess refunded as ERC-6909 claims to the swapping caller/router. During the fee window, exact-input buys and exact-output sells require a claim-aware router that redeems refunds before cash settlement and output-credit checks. A partial exact-output sell can return a negative raw IMD cash delta: a cash-only router may demand IMD on a sell, revert, or strand refunds; refund claims must be burned and the resulting currencyDelta used for net settlement. Fees round down, so dust fills may pay zero and even full fills may receive a one-unit refund claim. Anyone may sweep accrued IMD claims to the vault. For the first 60 minutes, each buy is capped at 10 million SPEPE. The token mints the entire 1 billion SPEPE supply to its deployer; distribution and opening price are set by the launch factory.
